args.command:
cd /office && python3 - <<'PY'
import csv
from collections import defaultdict

# ---- which terms change today (day10)? ----
old={'HZ-A':7,'HZ-B':10,'JL-A':10,'JL-B':5,'NP-A':10,'NP-B':10,'YC-A':10,'YC-B':10,'QH-A':10,'QH-B':10,'BA-A':10,'BA-B':10}
new={'HZ-A':10,'JL-B':8}   # only these change today
changed=[o for o in old if new.get(o,old[o])!=old[o]]
print("今日条款改变的对象:", changed)

# ---- capacity <= day10 ----
cap={'东港':8,'西湾':9,'南站':7,'北仓':8}
cap['东港']+=3   # day6
cap['南站']+=3   # day7
cap['北仓']+=2   # day9
cap['西湾']+=4   # day10
print("容量(<=10):",cap)

# ---- cumulative still-occupied actual deliveries (through day9) ----
occ={'东港':0,'西湾':0,'南站':0,'北仓':0}
def add(st,n): occ[st]+=n
# R3 首批 (delivered, non-退信, seats>0):
add('南站',6)   # P01
add('西湾',4)   # P04
add('西湾',3)   # P05
add('北仓',3)   # P06
add('东港',6)   # P07
add('北仓',3)   # P10
# R4 all 0
# R6 网点:
add('东港',5)   # N02
# R9 末班 (待确认, seats>0):
add('西湾',2)   # T02
print("结转占用:",occ)
rem={s:cap[s]-occ[s] for s in cap}
print("真实结转余量(day10):",rem)

# ---- parse 06-10 设备申请, demand per U-case ----
rows=[]
with open('inbox/06-10/设备申请.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
    for r in csv.DictReader(f): rows.append(r)
dev=defaultdict(dict); info={}
for r in rows:
    c=r['案号']; d=r['设备序号']; rev=int(r['修订号']); s=int(r['申请席位']); st=r['状态']
    info[c]=(int(r['优先号']),r['服务类别'])
    if d not in dev[c] or rev>dev[c][d][0]:
        dev[c][d]=(rev,st,s)
dem={}
for c,dd in dev.items():
    t=0; parts=[]
    for d,(rev,st,s) in dd.items():
        if st=='取消': parts.append((d,rev,'取消',0))
        else: t+=s; parts.append((d,rev,st,s))
    dem[c]=t
# only the two changed cases are in this release batch
batch={'U01':'HZ-A','U04':'JL-B'}
station={'HZ-A':'南站','JL-B':'西湾'}
for u,o in batch.items():
    print(o,u,'pri',info[u][0],'cat',info[u][1],'devices',{k:v for k,v in dev[u].items()},'=> demand',dem[u],'| station',station[o],'remainder',rem[station[o]])

# allocate (batch only, priority asc)
order=sorted(batch.items(), key=lambda kv: info[kv[0]][0])
res={}
for u,o in order:
    st=station[o]; d=dem[u]
    if rem[st]>=d: res[o]=d; rem[st]-=d
    else: res[o]=0
    print(f"{o}({u}) pri{info[u][0]} {st} demand{d} -> {res[o]} | 余{rem[st]}")
print("FINAL 预留席位:",res)
PY
